svg.title: C. elegans
svg.desc: Adult C. elegans shown as a slender translucent unsegmented nematode with tapered ends and a gently curved body. Biological basis: Caenorhabditis elegans is transparent, has a mapped cell lineage and nervous system, and supports rapid genetic and live-imaging experiments.
